summary: Iter-28 sprint fully validated end-to-end across backend (11/11 pytest) and frontend (all 6 flows). (1) ATTENDANCE-EMAIL: POST /api/live-sessions/{id}/mark-attendance to ATTENDED queues exactly one outbox row with template='live_session_attendance' for the learner; idempotent second mark does NOT re-queue (before → +1 → same). (2) STREAK LEADERBOARD: GET /api/gamification/streak-leaderboard returns {top, your_rank, your_entry, total_participants} with per-row keys (user_id, name, current_streak, longest_streak, active_today, is_you). Frontend on /courses shows 'Leaderboard' link next to '3-day streak' badge (open-streak-leaderboard testid); clicking opens streak-leaderboard-modal listing top with 'Test Learner (you)' row highlighted (is_you=true). Since caller is inside top 10 (only 1 participant), the streak-leaderboard-your-rank block is correctly not rendered. (3) COURSE-EDIT XL RIGHT-RAIL: On /courses/1/edit (viewport 1920) the right aside has class 'w-80 xl:w-[36rem] bg-white border-l p-4 overflow-y-auto' and the funnel-charts-grid has 'xl:grid xl:grid-cols-2 xl:gap-6 xl:items-start'. (4) SEO: GET /api/seo/robots.txt returns text/plain with 'Sitemap: …/api/seo/sitemap.xml' + Disallow /api/ /dashboard /admin; /api/seo/sitemap.xml returns application/xml with <urlset> containing /catalog + course URLs; /api/seo/sitemap-1.xml returns per-org sitemap for opted-in org 1 (200); /api/seo/sitemap-999999.xml → 404; frontend static /robots.txt (Cloudflare-prepended but appended IFPI block) contains 'Sitemap: /api/seo/sitemap.xml'. (5) BULK MARK-ATTENDANCE: mark-all-attended-btn present in AttendanceModal header when rsvps.length>0; when all learners already ATTENDED, clicking shows sonner info toast 'Everyone is already marked ATTENDED' and fires no request. (6) CERT SHARE (brag card): /certificates renders 28 cert-share-{id} buttons in fuchsia; clicking copies 'https://…/api/seo/certificates/share/{code}' to clipboard + toast 'Share link copied · paste on LinkedIn or Twitter for a rich preview'; GET /api/seo/certificates/share/{code} returns text/html with og:title, og:image, twitter:card=summary_large_image and the cert code in body; GET /api/certificates/verify/{code}/og-image.svg returns image/svg+xml starting with <?xml and containing 'CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT'. BOGUS code → 404 on both share HTML and og-image.svg.

issues: Cosmetic: Cloudflare Managed Content is prepended to /robots.txt at the edge (2260 bytes served vs 424 in public/robots.txt). Our IFPI block with 'Sitemap: /api/seo/sitemap.xml' is correctly appended at the bottom, so crawlers will still find the sitemap directive. Non-blocking — this is Cloudflare edge behaviour that can't be turned off from the app. If the org wants a fully-controlled robots.txt, we'd need a Cloudflare rule or serve /robots.txt via a backend route under /api/.

critical_code_review_comments: ATTENDANCE EMAIL PIPELINE (routers/live_sessions.py::_email_attendance_cert ~line 448) — Only fires MailService.send_email(template='live_session_attendance') on transition to ATTENDED, gated by the same (session_id, user_id) row check that guards cert issuance. Verified idempotent via a full before/after outbox count roundtrip (11/11 pytest). Body contains /api/certificates/{id}/pdf link and subject 'Your attendance certificate for {session title}'.

STREAK LEADERBOARD (routers/misc.py::streak_leaderboard) — Response shape {top, your_rank, your_entry, total_participants} is consistent and includes is_you per row. Frontend correctly hides streak-leaderboard-your-rank when caller is inside top 10 (in-top optimisation). Note: only 1 participant in the seed data — worth seeding a couple more learners for demo, but the code paths (top-10 highlight + separate your-rank block for out-of-top-10) are already correct and were exercised in prior E2E runs.

SEO ROUTER (routers/seo.py) — /api/seo/robots.txt correctly emits the Sitemap directive with the public base URL. Per-org sitemap 404s cleanly for non-opted-in orgs via a query on the marketplace_opt_in flag; opted-in orgs return only their published courses. sitemap.xml Content-Type is application/xml (charset defaulted by FastAPI). One observation: sitemap URLs use the internal cluster hostname (http://code-quality-check-31.cluster-11.preview.emergentcf.cloud) because it's derived from the incoming Host header at ingress. In production the public host resolves correctly, but for the preview URL you may want to force PUBLIC_BASE_URL env override so crawlers see the same hostname the user sees. Non-blocking for iter-28 since the paths still resolve.

COURSE EDIT AISDE (CourseEditPage.tsx) — Right aside class 'w-80 xl:w-[36rem]' correctly widens on ≥1280px. CourseFunnelPanel's funnel-charts-grid uses xl:grid + xl:grid-cols-2 + xl:gap-6 + xl:items-start — Daily trend + Slide drop-off render side-by-side at xl and stack on smaller viewports. LGTM.

BULK MARK-ATTENDANCE (AttendanceModal.tsx::markAllAttended) — Uses window.confirm() as the confirm gate, calls a single POST with user_ids=[all_unmarked]. Correctly short-circuits with an info toast when unmarked.length===0 (verified via UI). Toast copy 'N marked · X certificates issued' is emitted from the returned {marked, attendance_certs_issued} payload. Consider replacing window.confirm() with a shadcn AlertDialog in a future polish pass for on-brand UX, but functionally correct.

CERT SHARE (routers/seo.py::certificates_share + CertificatesPage.tsx) — Shareable HTML page returns proper og:title/og:image/og:description + twitter:card=summary_large_image; og:image URL correctly points to /api/certificates/verify/{code}/og-image.svg (1200x630 SVG). The frontend copyShareLink uses navigator.clipboard.writeText and shows a sonner toast; verified clipboard content matches the expected /api/seo/certificates/share/{code} URL. Fuchsia bg-fuchsia-600 button is visually distinct and accessible.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 UI/integration flows verified through the public URL)

seed_data_creation: test_iteration28_sprint.py creates TEST_iter28_email_* and TEST_iter28_bulk_* live sessions and auto-cleans them via finally: DELETE. UI runs did not create additional debris.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-28 sprint certified green end-to-end. This is expected. (2) SEO sitemap URLs use the cluster-internal hostname (…cluster-11.preview.emergentcf.cloud) rather than the preview.emergentagent.com hostname, because it's derived from the incoming Host header. When everyone is already ATTENDED, an info toast fires and no network request is made — verified.
